about: The parity ledger, 2026-11-22: one entry for each row of .mdmd/layer-2/parity.mdmd.md, whose table is printed from it (scripts/doc-tools/parity-table.ts). parity.test.ts runs each entry's command over the estate sample (`estate`) or a two-commit scripted repository with its history (`history`). An equivalent passes while its output holds every `expect` fragment; a gap passes while its output still holds its `symptom`, so that a mend which closes it fails the test until the row moves here in the same commit. A gap with no command is probed by the option its smallest design would take, refused today. `{first}` and `{last}` stand for the history's commits.
